_meta.description: Every change the daily Ads roster saw in an entity's typed field — a campaign renamed or paused, a budget or bid changed, a keyword's state — one row per field: old value, new value, when (detected_at; detected_on the marketplace day). The history behind the current-state rpt_ads_* entity tables.
caveats: A change is seen at the daily roster read, not when it was made: several edits in one day show as one change.
Values are text as the entity table stores them; state and match_type are upper-cased (case only, never a value mapping).
_meta.retention_note: kept 400 days by detected_on; older rows are pruned

columns.note: Internal tenant scope — auto-applied from `store`; never filter on it manually.
Marketplace code (UK/US/AE/...). Auto-filtered from the store suffix on per-marketplace tables.
Which ad product: 'Sponsored Products', 'Sponsored Brands', 'Sponsored Display' (title case). One table holds them all; filter or group on it.
UTC instant (timestamptz). Query results show it in the store ref's marketplace local time, without an offset; a bare date in a filter is that marketplace's midnight.
Ads profile id (one per marketplace) — auto-filtered from the store suffix; do not filter manually.
